'''Arch Witch''' was a title amongst the [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was bestowed upon [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sisters]] who occupied a higher position in the clan hierarchy. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Sister [[Azzenaj]] was an Arch Witch of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]].
